title: Errors in Long Equatorial Wave Models
exact_target: Explain and reduce the long-equatorial-wave errors in the report's otherwise globally valid wave model.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001533 (OWR-4415-006). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Theory and Modelling in Atmosphere-Ocean-Science (2010), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2010/34, pp. 2027--2099; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 39--40, printed pages 2065--2066.
equatorial-wave modeling study; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: The governing approximation, comparison solutions, and wave-scale regime must be inherited from the report. A universal error estimate for every equatorial-wave model is not supplied; the question is to identify missing dynamics and possible extensions across scales.
